# msr_physical_ai_layer
> Open-source Physical AI (robotics + autonomy) layer for Molten Salt Reactor
> operations. Provides a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling LLM agents
> (Claude Code, OpenClaw, OpenAI Codex, Cursor) to monitor and coordinate a
> 12-robot fleet for maintenance, inspection, sampling, and safety tasks in
> high-radiation MSR environments such as TMSR-LF1 (SINAP, China).

## Purpose
Use this repository to:
- Understand how physical-AI robotics integrates with MSR (Molten Salt Reactor) operations.
- Build or extend an MCP server that coordinates robots in nuclear facilities.
- Study a reference architecture for AI-driven maintenance of primary salt loops,
  hot-cell chemistry, radiation mapping, freeze-plug monitoring, and more.
- Connect the physical-AI layer to the MSR data layer (sensor RAG) and the
  msr-gstack multi-agent organisation.

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, tool table, quick start, and configuration.

## Quick agent setup
```bash
git clone https://github.com/pranavkantgaur/msr_physical_ai_layer
cd msr_physical_ai_layer
make install   # pip install -r requirements.txt
make test      # pytest -v (50 tests, all should pass)
make start     # launch MCP server on stdio
```

## MCP tools summary
| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| get_robot_fleet_status | All 12 robots: status, battery, radiation dose |
| get_robot_status | Single robot details + sensor readings |
| get_active_operations | Currently running tasks across the fleet |
| get_task_status | Status of a task by task_id |
| get_task_log | Recent task history |
| get_operational_areas | All 12 areas with descriptions and assigned robots |
| get_data_source_info | Data source connectivity info |
| dispatch_robot_task | Send a robot to perform a task |
| abort_robot_task | Abort current task, return robot to IDLE |

## Safety context
This server operates in nuclear environments:
- Robots face neutron fields, gamma radiation, and molten salt at 600–700 °C.
- abort_robot_task has no auto-retry; a single authoritative abort is the safe pattern.
- Radiation dose accumulation is tracked per robot (mSv).
- No autonomous hardware actuation without human-in-the-loop for safety-critical ops.
